provenance.purpose: deterministic fixture contract and reference calculation checks

generator.normal_transform: Box-Muller; consume u1,u2 pairs; cosine output then sine output
generator.portability: Repeatability is required within the same runtime. Python random stream compatibility does not guarantee cross-platform libm bitwise identity for log, sqrt, sin, or cos; the recorded digest is the observed CPython 3.14.7 reference, not a cross-platform promise.

reference_oracle.limit_basis: Deterministic fixture acceptance limits fixed before generating or estimating this sample. The mu limit equals 3*sigma/sqrt(n); the sigma absolute-error limit 0.019882 is deliberately slightly stricter than the approximate 3*sigma/sqrt(2*n)=0.019887378220871645 under IID uncensored Normal log values. These are not empirical confidence guarantees, clinical thresholds, or real-data fit criteria.

tail_oracle.count_range_basis: Fixture guard chosen before generating this sample from a Binomial(n=4096, p=0.01) tail-count model; the inclusive 21..61 band has approximately 99.855% coverage under the stated synthetic generator. This is not an inferential acceptance interval for empirical ED data.

limits: Synthetic data do not validate real ED data or operating ranges.
This fixture does not select a distribution, create an operational default, or perform empirical candidate fitting; empirical candidate comparison and diagnostics remain in P3.2.
Censoring, clustering, leakage, dependence, and identifiability are outside this fixture and remain with their separately bound P3.1 leaves.
The sample-size 30 state is fixture-only and is not a universal threshold.
